How to Play
Pet Planet is an idle pet-collection game: earn resources, craft eggs, hatch and collect pets, and make them stronger over time.
Getting Started
  1. Tap the egg on the home screen to earn Sparks and Shells. You keep earning while you're away (idle income).
  2. In the Shop, craft an Egg using Sparks + Shells. Rarer eggs need rarer Shells.
  3. Put the egg in the Hatchery and wait for it to hatch into a Pet.
  4. Equip your best pets in your active slots — their abilities boost your income and luck.
  5. Send pets on Adventures to earn rewards and pet XP over time.
  6. Use Fusion, Mutation and Reroll to improve your pets, and fill your Petdex.
Things You'll Find
Sparks
The main currency. Earned by tapping & idling. Spent on crafting eggs, buildings, upgrades and slots.
Buildings
Your idle engine. Each building generates Sparks over time — unlock and upgrade more to keep your income growing while you play and while you're away.
Shells
Egg-crafting material — one per region (Meadow → Cosmic). Each region's egg needs its own Shells. Combine 5 lower into 1 higher with Quick-fuse.
Gems
Premium currency. Used for speed-ups and cosmetics.
Eggs
Crafted from Sparks + Shells, then hatched in the Hatchery to become a pet.
Pets
Hatched from eggs. Each pet has abilities — equip them for bonuses, send them on adventures, or fuse and mutate them.
⭐
Abilities
Every pet ability has a tier — a higher tier means a bigger bonus (e.g. Spark Gain, Shell Gain, Luck).
Mutation Core
Made by Extracting an ability from a pet (that pet is destroyed). Apply it in the Mutation Chamber to place that ability on another pet — the pet survives.
🎲
Reroll Charm
Re-rolls the tier of one ability on a pet — it can go up or down. The rerolled ability becomes locked. Charms drop from gameplay.
Pet Abilities
⭐
How abilities work
Only your active (equipped) pets give their bonuses, and matching bonuses from all your active pets add together. Each ability has a tier — a higher tier gives a bigger boost.
Spark Gain
Boosts how many Sparks you earn — your income goes up both while you play and while you're away.
Offline Gain
You keep earning Sparks while the game is closed. This raises how much you collect when you come back.
Click Power
Makes every tap on the egg worth more Sparks.
Luck
Raises the chance that a Shell drops when you tap and while you idle.
Shell Drop
When a Shell drops, you get more Shells from it.
Hatch Speed
Eggs in the Hatchery finish hatching faster.
